test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 08 Jul, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate homophone to fill in the blank.

These people are artists. ________ skills are extraordinary.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Their"** is a possessive adjective used to indicate that something belongs to or is associated with a group of people or things. (उनका)

 
 
• **Example: **The students left **their** books on the table.
 
 
 
• **"Their" **is used to show possession, indicating that the skills belong to the artists. (उनका)
 
 
• **Example: Their **house is the one with the red door.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **There **(वहां): Refers to a place or position.

 
 
• **Example:** The book is over **there** on the shelf.
 
 
 
• **They’re **(वे हैं): Contraction of "they are".
 
 
• **Example: They’re** going to the park this afternoon.
 
 
 
• **They** (वे): Used to refer to two or more people or things previously mentioned or easily identified.
 
 
• **Example: They** are very talented artists.
